items.title: Nine in 10 mid-market UK and Ireland firms faced disruption, Chubb survey finds
items.summary: Chubb's Middle Market Risk Radar shows widespread disruption among growing businesses, though nearly one in five firms operating internationally lacks overseas insurance.

items.title: Professional Pensions announces winners of the 2026 Rising Star Awards
items.summary: Professional Pensions has revealed the winners of its 2026 Rising Star Awards, recognising emerging talent and development initiatives across the sector at a London ceremony.

items.title: Mapfre raises €1bn in dual debt issuance to fund Safety Insurance acquisition
items.summary: Spanish insurer Mapfre has raised €1 billion through senior and subordinated bond issuances to help finance its acquisition of US-based Safety Insurance Group.

items.title: Aviva combines UK Commercial and Private Clients under Ann Owen
items.summary: Ann Owen steps up to manage both arms following David Martin's departure, with Kate Wells taking over the Aviva Private Clients managing director role.

items.title: Catastrophe losses push Allianz P&C combined ratio to 93.8% in third quarter
items.summary: Allianz reported a record nine-month operating profit, though property-casualty underwriting felt the impact of higher third-quarter catastrophe activity.

items.title: Marco Capital appoints Rob Gibbs as PoloWorks chief executive
items.summary: Rob Gibbs joins PoloWorks from SiriusPoint to lead the insurance services group through its combination with Pro Global.
